data.long_description:
Spacious 2-Bedroom Apartment in Xenia Residences, JVC

Welcome to this well-appointed 2-bedroom apartment in Xenia Residences, Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a generous 1,514 sq. ft. of living space. Designed for comfort and functionality, the apartment features 3 bathrooms, making it ideal for families or professionals seeking extra convenience.

The unit offers a well-proportioned living and dining area, a modern kitchen with sleek finishes, and two spacious bedrooms fitted with built-in wardrobes. Large windows enhance the space with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the home.

Key Features:

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Area: 1,514 sq. ft.
Practical and spacious layout
Built-in wardrobes
Contemporary design

Residence Amenities:

Swimming pool
Gymnasium
24-hour security
Designated parking

Located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Xenia Residences offers easy access to major roads, nearby parks, schools, and everyday conveniences, making it a great option for both end-users and investors.
